data.name: Ilhaamah
data.gender_notes: Ilhaamah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who gives a whisper, a divine revelation from Allah. The name Ilhaamah carries the meaning “Whisper, Revelation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ilhaamah usually hope their child will grow to embody whisper, revelation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child believed to be a spiritual guide or messenger, sent from Allah
data.etymology: Ilhaamah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Whisper, Revelation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ilhaamah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: إلهامة
in_arabic.meaning: إلهامة تعني الإلهام أو الفكر العميق
in_arabic.long_meaning: إلهامة هي اسم يوحي بالإلهام أو الفكر العميق، وقد وردت كلمة الإلهام في القرآن الكريم بمعنى الإلهام الإلهي، وتعني إلهامة في اللغة العربية الإلهام أو الفكر العميق الذي يلهمه الله تعالى لعباده.

in_urdu.name: الہامہ
in_urdu.meaning: الہامہ کا مطلب ہے الہام یا گہرا سوچ
in_urdu.long_meaning: الہامہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو الہام یا گہرے سوچ کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے۔ عربی زبان میں الہامہ کا مطلب ہے الہام یا گہرا سوچ جس کی وجہ اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں کو بخشتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इलहामा
in_hindi.meaning: इलहामा का अर्थ है ईश्वरीय प्रेरणा या गहन विचार
in_hindi.long_meaning: इलहामा एक ऐसा नाम है जो ईश्वरीय प्रेरणा या गहन विचार की ओर संकेत करता है। इस नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية भाषा से हुई है, जहां इसका अर्थ है ईश्वरीय प्रेरणा या गहन विचार जो अल्लाह अपने सेवकों को प्रदान करता है।

in_pashto.name: الهامہ
in_pashto.meaning: الهامہ د الهيام یا ژورنۍ فکر معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: الهامہ یو داسې نوم دی چی د الهيام یا ژورنۍ فکر په لور اشاره کوي. په عربي ژبه کې د الهامہ مطلب د الهيام یا ژورنۍ فکر دی چې الله تعالیٰ خپلو بندګانو ته ورکوي.

in_english.name: Ilhaamah
in_english.meaning: Ilhaamah means divine inspiration or profound thought
in_english.long_meaning: Ilhaamah is a name that signifies divine inspiration or profound thought. Etymologically derived from Arabic roots, the name Ilhaamah is associated with the concept of ilham, which refers to divine inspiration or guidance provided by Allah to His servants. This name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting the aspirational qualities of seeking knowledge and wisdom.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ilhaamah was the name of a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Ilhaamah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ilhaamah was a member of the Ansar, the early supporters of Islam in Medina.

trends: Classic Islamic name maintaining steady popularity
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ilhaamah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
